title: Untrusted data reaches an HTML or DOM execution sink
preconditions: server template output is embedded into an HTML/JS context
dangerous_transitions: untrusted value enters an executable markup/script context without context-appropriate encoding
sink_semantics: React dangerouslySetInnerHTML and unescaped server template output
counterevidence: The framework uses context-correct escaping and no raw HTML sink receives attacker-controlled data.
verification_recipe: Trace the value into the final browser/template context and inspect sanitization order.
Use a harmless markup sentinel and a context-matched encoded control.
